tests.description: Analyzes red blood cells, white blood cells, haemoglobin, and platelets to detect anemia, infections, or leukemia.
tests.preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Avoid heavy fatty meals before the blood draw.

tests.description: Measures total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, and triglycerides to estimate cardiovascular risk.
tests.preparationInstructions: Fasting of 10-12 hours is mandatory. Only water is allowed during the fasting period.

tests.description: Evaluates the activity of your thyroid gland to screen for hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism.
tests.preparationInstructions: Fasting preferred but not mandatory. Morning sample recommended.

tests.description: Measures your average blood sugar levels over the past 2 to 3 months to monitor or diagnose Glycemia.
tests.preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Can be done at any time of the day.

tests.description: Measures enzymes, proteins, and bilirubin levels to check how well your liver is functioning.
tests.preparationInstructions: Fasting of 8-10 hours is recommended before the test.

tests.description: Measures concentration of Vitamin D in blood. Essential for healthy bones, immune function, and overall cellular vitality.
tests.preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Morning collection is preferred.
